name: Gauntlets of Chaos — Permanent B shares with A one of artifact, creature or land
notes: "{5}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exchange control of target artifact, creature, or land you control and target permanent an opponent controls that shares one of those types with it." (2026-10-18.) No shared-type rule was set and B was held to A's "artifact, creature, or land". With Forest as A, B lists only the opponent's Island (not their Grizzly Bears, Mind Stone or Glorious Anthem), and the pair Forest / Mind Stone set anyway is refused by the engine.
